methods.name: Quest skip to level 32
methods.note: Shadow of the Storm put on Ranged, Death to the Dorgeshuun and Horror from the Deep give 16,662 XP. Temple of Ikov adds 10,500 for level 36.

methods.name: Dwarf multicannon on ogres
methods.note: Ogres east of Castle Wars, about 40k from the cannon alone. Fastest to 45 but pricey. The ironman guide only rates it for 40 to 70 with self-made cannonballs.

methods.name: Gemstone Crab
methods.note: Rapid style. Steel then mithril darts, an adamant crossbow with ruby bolts (e) at 46, a rosewood blowpipe with adamant darts at 65. Rate estimated: the wiki gives none.

methods.name: Gemstone Crab with Dorgeshuun crossbow
methods.req: q:Children of the Sun|The Lost Tribe
methods.note: Bone bolts from Nardok are very cheap. 14.5k to 27k an hour, about 7 hours from 28 to 55. Mains should use darts, which hit harder.

methods.name: Loar shades with knives
methods.note: Mort'ton. Bronze knives, green d'hide and Ava's attractor. Their flat armour of -3 suits fast thrown weapons. Up to 50k an hour. Listed for 40 to 55.

methods.name: Jungle spiders with knives or darts
methods.note: Safespot the spiders at Hazelmere's hut near Yanille. Flat armour of -2 suits fast thrown weapons. Up to 40k an hour. Listed for 40 to 55.

methods.name: Chinning maniacal monkeys (grey chins)
methods.note: Kruk's Dungeon, MM2 started. Wiki rates assume best gear, Rigour, divine potions and two alts stacking the monkeys. About 1,970 chins an hour.

methods.name: Chinning maniacal monkeys (red chins)
methods.note: Ironmen hunt their own red chins, best at the Gwenith or the hard Western Provinces diary hunting grounds. Rates assume best gear, Rigour and alts stacking.

methods.name: Chinning maniacal monkeys (black chins)
methods.note: Fastest Ranged XP in the game. Black chins are caught in the Wilderness, so ironmen risk PKers for them. Rates assume best gear, Rigour and alts stacking.

methods.name: Pest Control points
methods.note: Veteran boat, about 26 games an hour, points spent 100 at a time. Rates are with no combat achievements. The hard tier gives 98k at 70 up to 157k at 98.

methods.name: Slayer tasks and bosses with Ranged
methods.note: Blowpipe or venator bow on task, or bosses like Zulrah, Hydra, shamans and demonic gorillas. Neither guide calls it efficient or gives a rate.

methods.name: Nightmare Zone with venator bow
methods.note: Normal rumble with absorptions and super ranging, one click per 20 minutes. Rate is quoted at 99. Magic shortbow (i) or darts are cheaper and slower.

methods.name: Maniacal monkeys with venator bow
methods.note: Cheaper, slower alternative to chinning with amethyst arrows. 140k to 230k an hour, 240k near 99. Prayer potion drops let you stay until 99.

unverified: Quest skip to level 32: one-off quest XP, so no hourly rate (xph 0)
Dwarf multicannon on ogres: 40,000 is 'from the cannon alone' and no rate by level is given; the Ironman Guide intro says it does not recommend the cannon but still lists it for 40-70
Gemstone Crab: no XP rate for darts, blowpipe or ruby bolts in either guide or on Gemstone Crab/Strategies (xph 0)
Gemstone Crab with Dorgeshuun crossbow: the guide says 'between 14,500 and 27,000' over levels 28-55; treated as the rate at 28 and at 55
Loar shades with knives: 42,500 is 85% of 'up to 50,000'
Jungle spiders with knives or darts: 34,000 is 85% of 'up to 40,000'

Chinning maniacal monkeys (all three): table rates assume best gear, Rigour, divine ranging potions and two alt accounts stacking the monkeys; Eagle Eye is 5-7% lower; only needs Monkey Madness II started, req lists the quest as if complete
Chinning maniacal monkeys (red chins): the Ironman Guide starts chinning at 55 with self-caught red chins and gives no rate of its own
Pest Control points: bands are the no-combat-achievement column (5 points a game); combat level 100 is 'recommended' for the veteran boat and is what the rates assume
Slayer tasks and bosses with Ranged: no rate in either guide (xph 0)

Nightmare Zone with venator bow: 123,000 is 85% of the midpoint of 'up to 140,000-150,000', which is quoted at level 99, not at 80; hard mode is 180,000-190,000; the Ironman Guide lists NMZ from 55 with no rate; the 5-quest requirement cannot be expressed in req
Maniacal monkeys with venator bow: midpoint of 140,000-230,000; the guide says a realistic maximum is 240,000 near 99
Not included: chinning skeletal monkeys (no rate, only for players without MM2) and the eclipse atlatl (a weapon choice, no rate)

2026-10-05: Gemstone Crab (melee) rate is computed in app.js (CALC['crab-melee']) from the damage formula, not taken from the wiki; Nightmare Zone is flagged 'setup' (dream fee, potions, five quests) so AFK blocks weigh it at 75%

2026-10-05: Gemstone Crab (ranged) rate is computed in app.js (CALC['crab-ranged']) from the weapon progression on Gemstone Crab/Strategies and the item pages (steel dart +3, mithril +9, adamant +17 ranged strength, speed 3; adamant crossbow speed 6; ruby bolts (e) +103 and about 60 damage every ~20 attacks; rosewood blowpipe +6, speed 3 in PvM, 65 Ranged); rapid style, no potions or prayer, 97% hit chance on the zero-defence crab, 87.5% XP
